vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look, it's raining! Where does rain come from?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: I know! A giant up in the sky has a big watering can!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Good guess, Leo! What a funny idea. But rain comes from... the clouds!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: From the clouds? But how does the water get up there?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's follow one tiny drop of water. Meet Drippy!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Hi! I'm Drippy the raindrop! Come on an adventure with me!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Question one. How does Drippy get up into the sky?

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: I'm in the big blue sea. The warm sun shines on me. Ooh, I feel warm!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: I get so light, I float up, up, up! You can't see me now!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Point up with Drippy! Up, up, up!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: High in the sky, it's cold! Brrr! I turn back into a tiny drop.

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: And look! Lots of tiny drops, all together. We make a cloud!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Question two. Why does rain fall down?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Inside the cloud, the tiny drops bump into each other, and join together.

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Bump! I get bigger. Bump! Bigger! Bump! Bigger!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Say it with Drippy! Bump! Bigger!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: When the drops get big and heavy, the cloud can't hold them anymore.

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Whoa! Here I go! Wheee! I'm rain!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Question three. Where does the rain go?

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Splash! I land on a hill, and I slide down into a river.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Some raindrops help the flowers and trees drink, and grow.

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: The river takes me all the way back to the sea!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And then the sun warms the water again, and up, up, up it goes!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Up, cloud, rain, and back to the sea. Round and round! This is called the water cycle.

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Wa-ter cy-cle! Your turn!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Whoa! So rain is the same water, going round and round!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Yes! The water in your bath was in a cloud, long, long ago!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: We can make rain in a jar! Ask a grown-up to help.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step one. A grown-up pours warm water into a jar.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Step two. Put a plate on top, with ice cubes on it.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Now, wait, and watch.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Look! Tiny drops under the cold plate. They get bigger, and... drip, drip! Rain!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: We made rain! Hooray!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Prof. Hoot, are raindrops pointy, like this?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Good question! Real raindrops are not pointy. Small ones are round, like little balls.

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And big ones look a bit like a tiny bun! Wow!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A bun? Now I'm hungry!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Look! The sun is back. And... a rainbow!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: When sunshine shines through the raindrops, it makes a rainbow!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Thank you, rain!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where does rain come from?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: From the clouds!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What makes the water go up into the sky?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The warm sun!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Why do the drops fall down?

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: They get big and heavy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where does the river take Drippy?

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Back to the sea!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What do we call it, when water goes round and round?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The water cycle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What do we see, when the sun shines through raindrops?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: A rainbow!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: Let's say it all together!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Up, up, up!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Cloud!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Rain!

vo.speaker: hoot
vo.text: And round again!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Up, up, up! Cloud! Rain! And round again!

vo.speaker: drippy
vo.text: Thanks for coming on my adventure! Bye-bye!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: See you next time, friends!
